correctness.rationale: For α=v∧β and v≠0, a bivector quotient β of alternating rank2 is simple and gives a three-dimensional divisor space; rank≥4 gives unique divisor line. The incidence Z=Tot(L⊗Λ²Q) over P(V) is smooth irreducible and proper over X_n, of dimension (n−1)+binom(n−1,2)=binom(n,2), birational over the unique-divisor stratum with a regular kernel-line inverse. At α decomposable with factor space U, the tangent space contains U∧Λ²V of dimension binom(n,3)−binom(n−3,3)=binom(n,2)+(n−5)(n−2), proving singularity for n≥6; the origin has full ambient tangent. Simple trivectors form cone Gr(3,V), dimension3n−8. Count unique divisor lines by Gaussian binomials and non-simple bivector quotients; the n6 exterior perfect pairing yields wedge ranks (1,6−d,6−d,1) and homology (0,d,9+d,18,9+d,d,0). Independent q2 n6/7 finite-field Gaussian arithmetic gives n6 counts 1395, 54684, 992496 and n7 counts 11811,4078732,34355647824; all-parameter proof is geometric rather than finite enumeration.
